categories.main_business_segments: LONGi Green Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the photovoltaic (PV) industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of monocrystalline silicon rods and wafers, solar cells and modules, as well as the development and operation of photovoltaic power stations. The company also engages in distributed PV solutions, ground PV solutions, and hydrogen energy equipment, forming a comprehensive 'green electricity' and 'green hydrogen' product and solution portfolio.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced PV technologies including HPBC 2.0 back-contact solar cells, high-quality 'Tai Rui' silicon wafers produced via TRCz crystal pulling technology, and next-generation BC platform technologies. It emphasizes vertical integration with intelligent manufacturing, cost-effective production methods, and continuous R&D in silicon wafer, solar cell, and module technologies, including innovations in crystalline silicon-perovskite tandem cells and hybrid back-contact cells.
categories.primary_customers_markets: LONGi serves a global customer base across over 160 countries and regions, including key markets such as China, the United States, Europe, India, Australia, the Middle East, and Africa. Its customers range from large-scale ground power plants, distributed residential and commercial users, to emerging markets requiring customized PV solutions. The company also targets industrial, transportation, and building-integrated PV applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing bases and R&D centers primarily in China (Shaanxi, Ningxia, Yunnan, Inner Mongolia, Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang), Malaysia, and the United States (joint ventures). It has established a global marketing and service network with branches in the US, Japan, Germany, India, Australia, UAE, and Thailand, supporting a diversified global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: LONGi occupies an upstream to midstream position in the photovoltaic supply chain, producing core materials such as monocrystalline silicon rods and wafers, solar cells, and modules. It also extends downstream into PV power station development and operation, as well as hydrogen energy equipment manufacturing, thus covering a broad vertical integration within the PV industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes product and technology leadership, focusing on scaling HPBC 2.0 technology and BC platform industrialization. It emphasizes customer-driven product development, cost optimization, and global capacity expansion with a shift towards light-asset overseas manufacturing. R&D efforts target high-efficiency solar cells, including crystalline silicon-perovskite tandem cells, and integration of PV with green hydrogen solutions to support energy transition.
categories.revenue_model: LONGi generates revenue primarily through the sale of photovoltaic products including silicon wafers, solar cells, and modules. It also earns income from PV power station construction and operation services, as well as hydrogen energy equipment sales. The company’s revenue is derived from product sales, project development contracts, and related services across domestic and international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: LONGi is a global leader in the photovoltaic industry, holding the top position in cumulative shipments of monocrystalline silicon wafers over the past decade and ranking among the top two in solar module shipments over the past six years. It competes with other major PV manufacturers globally, leveraging its technological innovation, cost leadership, and extensive global footprint to maintain a leading market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, LONGi reported revenue of approximately RMB 82.58 billion, a 36.23% decline year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 8.62 billion, marking its first loss since listing due to industry supply-demand imbalance and price declines. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 152.84 billion and a healthy financial structure with a debt ratio below 60%, supporting ongoing R&D and capacity investments despite short-term challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: LONGi emphasizes high-efficiency, cost-effective, and reliable photovoltaic products with advanced back-contact cell technology delivering industry-leading conversion efficiencies and enhanced durability. Its product portfolio offers differentiated features such as aesthetic design, multi-scenario adaptability, and superior safety performance. The company’s integrated global supply chain, strong brand reputation, and commitment to sustainable green energy solutions underpin its competitive advantage.
